name: OET Medicine
description: Occupational English Test for doctors. Accepted by ECFMG as proof of English proficiency (OET Medicine, taken at a test venue or OET@Home).

facts.value: ECFMG requires a minimum grade of B (350) in each of the four sub-tests, in a single sitting, within 2 years of application
Listening ~45 min, Reading 60 min, Writing 45 min, Speaking ~20 min
Each sub-test scored 0-500, reported with letter grades A (450-500), B (350-440), C+ (300-340), C (200-290), D (100-190), E (0-90)

children.name: Part A: expeditious reading of four short texts
Part B: six short workplace texts (MCQ)
